question: To change the desktop wallpaper, which option would you choose?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Settings > Personalization**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To change the **desktop wallpaper** in a Windows operating system, users need to navigate to the **Settings menu**. Within this menu, the specific option to customize the wallpaper is found under Personalization__.
 
• The **Settings > Personalization** option provides access to themes, background settings, color customization, and lock screen preferences.
 
• Within the __Personalization__ menu, users can choose from various options such as a **picture, solid color, or slideshow** to set as the desktop wallpaper.
 
• Other options in the Personalization menu include customizing themes, fonts, and the start menu, but changing the wallpaper is one of the most common actions available here.
 
• Thus, selecting **Settings > Personalization** is the correct procedure to change the desktop wallpaper.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Settings > Devices:**

 
 
• This option is used to manage **connected devices**, such as printers, Bluetooth devices, and other peripherals.
 
• It does not provide customization options for wallpapers or themes.
 
 
 
• **Settings > Ease of Access:**
 
 
• This section is focused on **accessibility settings** for users with disabilities or special requirements.
 
• It allows adjustments such as text-to-speech, magnifier settings, high contrast mode, and captions but is unrelated to wallpaper customization.
 
 
 
• **Settings > Apps:**
 
 
• The **Apps section** allows users to manage installed applications, set default apps, and configure app permissions.
 
• It does not provide any settings for changing the desktop wallpaper.
 
 
 
• **Personalization Options:**
 
 
• Under **Personalization**, users can change the **background image** or color by selecting the "Background" tab.
 
• There is also an option to use a **slideshow** that rotates through selected photos as the desktop wallpaper.
 
• Furthermore, users can customize the **theme**, which includes settings for background, colors, and sounds.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Steps to Change the Desktop Wallpaper in Windows:**

 
 
• Right-click on the desktop and select **Personalize**.
 
• Alternatively, open the **Settings** app using the Start menu or by pressing **Win + I**.
 
• Navigate to **Settings > Personalization > Background**.
 
• In the Background section, choose one of the following: **Picture, Solid Color, or Slideshow**.
 
• Browse and select the desired image or color, and it will be applied as your desktop wallpaper.
